title: Leverage
description:
S02 E01 — The Beantown Bailout Job
Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:

The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E04 — The Date Night Job
While staging a date-night experience for "Parker and Hardison" at a freeport facility, the team comes across another heist in progress and must stop it to save the life of a 13-year-old boy.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E05 — A Walk in the Woods Job
While investigating the mysterious death of Eliot's friend, the team infiltrates an infamous enclave of power to take down the corrupt head of a private security company.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E07 — Uncle Danny
Alex's con-artist uncle comes for a visit to make amends and Alex finds himself caught between protecting the world from his uncle and protecting his uncle from Kai and Ernesto, as well as a mafia enforcer.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E08 — Lone Wolf
When Alex takes a job protecting a country singer he idolizes, he quickly learns that one should never meet one's heroes; when the singer is kidnapped, Alex must figure out who is really behind the crime and rescue him before it's too late.

description:

The crew must decide the best way forward with or without help from their nemesis, Evelyn Maddox.

description:
